associations.rationale: For an irreducible module of dimension lam + 1, the type gives an sl(2)-module equivalence with the standard model, but it does not itself assert existence of that irreducible model or display the E, F, and H matrices required by the complete claim.
This is the dimension computation for the standard model, supporting the classification theorem.
This establishes irreducibility of the standard model, a supporting property of the classification.
This is one basis-action formula for E, supporting the stated explicit standard matrices.
This is an interior basis-action formula for F, supporting the stated explicit standard matrices.
This is the top-basis-vector formula for F, supporting the stated explicit standard matrices.
This is one basis-action formula for H, supporting the stated explicit standard matrices.
